Hey babe, wake up… your job just added loot boxes for PTO.

Yeah… this is real.

In this video, we’re looking at companies turning time off into a raffle, donating for work-from-home days, and the classic “we care about you” HR systems that somehow still protect the company first.

Because when you actually break it down…
you’re either paying for your own day off…
or paying for someone else’s.

We also get into how these programs work, why they exist, and what’s actually happening behind the scenes.

Just adding some context to all
title: YOUR JOB JUST ADDED LOOT BOXES FOR TIME OFF!
